name: Hourglass Fantasy -Haru to Fuyu no Chouniwa-
source:
――Let time flow, following its natural course.

A short fantasy story of an hourglass set in a seasonal garden.

[Edited from [url=https://arborlune.itch.io/05hourglass]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
——让时间顺其自然地流淌。

一则关于沙漏的奇幻短篇，发生在四季流转的花园里。

［编译自[url=https://arborlune.itch.io/05hourglass]itch.io[/url]］
